name: Dondakaya Fry
ingredients: 500g Ivy Gourd (Dondakaya), sliced into thin rounds
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan and add mustard seeds, cumin, urad dal, and chana dal; fry until golden.
2. Add the dried red chilies and fresh curry leaves, sautéing briefly.
3. Add the sliced ivy gourd to the pan, sprinkle with salt and turmeric, and stir well.
4. Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally, without covering the pan to ensure the gourd remains crispy rather than soggy.
5. Once the gourd is cooked through and starts to brown, add the red chili powder, coriander powder, and roasted peanuts.
6. Sauté for another 3-5 minutes on low heat until the spices coat the vegetables evenly.
7. Turn off the heat, garnish with grated coconut, and serve hot with steamed rice and dal.
description: Dondakaya Fry is a quintessential staple in Andhra households. It highlights the regional preference for 'poriyal' or 'fry' style vegetable preparations that offer a perfect crunch and balance of spice. It is often prepared as a side dish for lunch, paired with pappu (lentil stew) and hot rice, embodying the humble yet flavor-rich culinary tradition of the Telugu people.
